news.headline: Bitcoin Pumps as Fed Signals Rate Pause, $415 Million in Shorts Get Rekt
news.summary: Stocks and crypto surged in tandem after Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled openness to pausing rate hikes, triggering a sharp squeeze that left short sellers on the losing end of a volatile move.

news.headline: Sony Dismisses PS5 Buyers' $508M Tariff Refund Claim as 'Illogical'
news.summary: Sony raised PS5 prices for a second time in March, just five weeks after tariffs were struck down—dismissing buyers' $508M refund claims as illogical. The timing has fueled frustration among consumers who argue the price hikes were unjustified given the tariff relief.

educational.title: What Is Bitcoin's 'Halving' and Why Does It Matter?
points: Roughly every 4 years, Bitcoin's mining reward is cut in half by design
This slows how fast new bitcoin enters circulation, capping supply growth
It's baked into the code — no company or person decides when it happens
Historically, halvings have preceded major price cycles, though it's not guaranteed
The last coin will ever be mined around the year 2140 due to this schedule
